trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this pops on its own. Everything is offline and single-player, one playthrough is enough, and the longest road is the 100% checklist for A Long Road. Expect around 200 hours in total, most of it after the story.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy. It pops when you finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission that introduces Lucia and Jason. Unmissable — just play the opening.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 1. Keep playing the main missions after the opening and it unlocks as the story moves on. Unmissable.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 2. Same rule as the other chapter trophies: play the main story and it pops on its own. Unmissable.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 3. Unmissable — it comes with story progress.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 4. Unmissable.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the final mission. Finish the story and it pops; free roam continues afterwards, so nothing is lost by finishing. Unmissable.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy for Breakfast Run. Play the main missions and it unlocks in order. Unmissable.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy for The Cartel Heist. Unmissable — it pops when the heist mission ends.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy for Child's Play. Unmissable.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy for Headliners. Unmissable.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the VCIA Takedown. Unmissable.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy for Operation Savage Glory. Unmissable.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The 100% completion trophy and the hardest one in the set. The in-game 100% checklist unlocks once you finish the story (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion) and tracks everything: missions, activities, collectibles and the big counters. Do not chase it during the story — finish the story first, then use the checklist to mop up in free roam. Community guides put the whole platinum at around 200 hours, most of it on this checklist. The checklist is lenient: for example only 70 of the 80 challenges and 15 of the 18 card sets count toward it.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts are the small stunt actions scattered across Leonida — jumps, near misses and the like. There are 397 in total, so you need a little over half. Work through them region by region in free roam after the story.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. There are nine activity types in the game — shooting ranges, races, fishing, arcade, bowling, drone races and the rest. Sample one of each and it pops; you do not need to finish any of them.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges — 42 gold medals in total. Each range has its own set of challenges; accuracy and speed both count toward the score, so learn the scoring and repeat a challenge until you clear the gold threshold.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — 14 locations. Learn each course's line, then win them one by one; the races are short, so a loss costs little.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any 20 distinct race events count — road, off-road, boat or air. Pick the ones you are best at and work through the list.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal and take his challenge, then out-fish him — steady reeling and watching the line tension beats rushing it.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Walk into any arcade, pick a cabinet and play it through to the end. Any game counts.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's stranger strand — play his missions to the last one. Stranger missions appear across Leonida as you explore; take them when they show up, since several are only offered for a while.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's stranger strand, to the final mission. Same approach as the other stranger lines: follow the strand whenever it appears.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's stranger strand, to the final mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. There are more than eight strangers — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret and others — so pick the eight whose missions you finish first. Stranger missions are not part of the 100% checklist, so do them as clean-up after the story.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's stranger strand, to the final mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's stranger strand, to the final mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every one of the 18 spots across Leonida. Meditation spots are quiet scenic places scattered around the state — the counter only moves when you meditate at a spot you have not used before. This is the one trophy community guides flag as possibly missable (GTABase and PowerPyx): the first meditation is a Chapter 1 moment with Lucia at Jason's house — after the mission Down to Earth, look for Lucia at the house in the morning and follow her to the balcony. Do not leave it for later: meditate at each spot as you find it, and check your count as you explore new areas. The full spot list is still being mapped by the community — follow the GTABase and PowerPyx guides for the current list.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunts ask for one specific animal — track it with the tools the game gives you and take the shot cleanly. His strand is one of the stranger lines, so follow it when it appears.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida in 18 sets; you only need 3 full sets for this trophy (15 count toward 100%). Pick up cards as you explore — a card map from a community guide saves a lot of wandering.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Use the WAiNK app to scan unfamiliar vehicles and places as you travel — the counter climbs fastest if you scan everything new you pass. There are more than 100 scannable spots, so keep the app open while you explore.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. The game has 80 challenges in eight groups of ten, and only 70 count toward 100% — so you can skip the hardest ones. Work through the groups you enjoy first and let the counter build up.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get into trouble together until the wanted level hits four stars, then break line of sight and lay low until it cools off. Best done in open country with a fast car ready.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Hit three shops in a row while the wanted level stays live — plan a route through three close shops and keep moving. If the heat drops between robberies, the chain breaks.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. The game counts each new vehicle model you find — drive everything you see, especially the rare ones. Only 200 of the 277 base models count toward 100%, so keep scanning with WAiNK as you go.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus in a fight with a group close together and drop five before it ends — a tight gang shootout is the natural place.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Leave Vice City International Airport by air on your own terms instead of following the usual route out. The exact trigger is still being pinned down by the community — check the GTABase and PowerPyx guides for the current method.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Get into a Rhino tank and put it through its paces — the trophy is tied to tank action, so find one (military areas are the usual source) and drive it into the thick of things.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: avoid cameras and guards, take what you need and leave before anyone raises the alarm. A careful approach beats a fast one.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Vault robberies are the bigger bank jobs — five of them, each with a clean getaway. The 100% checklist counts eight vault robberies, so this trophy comes on the way to 100%.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Watch for armored trucks on the road, hit one, grab the cash and get clear before the response arrives.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Visit every named area of the state — the map fills in as you travel, so a systematic drive through each region does it. Check your map for the gaps.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Every gang runs illegal operations; hit one per gang. The 100% checklist counts 39 gang operations in total, so this comes naturally on the way to 100%.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Find the Ocean Beach spot with the view, order a cocktail and take the moment in. This is a quiet one-off — the exact spot is still being mapped by the community, so check the GTABase guide for the current location.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. During a showroom robbery, drive out through the storefront instead of using the door — the classic GTA exit. The exact mission trigger is still being confirmed by the community, so check the GTABase and PowerPyx guides before you try it.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go to the bowling alley and play through — a full follow-through on the lanes. The exact requirement is still being confirmed by the community; check the GTABase guide for the current method.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. This one is tied to a partner moment — the exact unlock is still being confirmed by the community, so treat it as one to watch for while playing with your partner, and check the GTABase and PowerPyx guides for the current method.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). This pops at a story choice — one of the decisions the game asks you to make. Which choice is still being confirmed by the community; it comes up naturally as you play the story.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. This suggests failing something once, then succeeding on the second attempt. The exact trigger is still being confirmed by the community — check the GTABase and PowerPyx guides for the current method.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? A hidden trophy whose unlock method is still unconfirmed — community guides list it as unknown for now. Do not chase it blindly; follow the GTABase and PowerPyx guides as the method is confirmed.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. At the bowling alley, take someone down with a melee attack from a vehicle. The precise setup is still being confirmed by the community — check the KeenGamer and GTABase guides for the current method.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies — launder them through your contacts a little at a time and the total climbs. It pairs naturally with the robbery trophies.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy cars, clothes, weapons and upgrades — every shop purchase counts toward the total. It adds up fast once you start spending robbery money.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. There are eight purchasable garages — buy them all. They also give you somewhere to store the vehicles you collect.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find ten vehicles and register each one through the app. Any ten count, so use the common ones you pass every day.
